prompt:
Generate one high-quality cinematic 16:9 image for the specified section, not a generic slide or dashboard. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows, diagrams, interface, checkmarks, traffic-light statuses or readable documents. The compositor adds every semantic mark independently. Do not invent a completed publication, a live security test, a solved outing, approval or consensus. Fictional editorial staging, not documentary evidence. Rich material detail, carefully controlled light, credible objects and hands. Keep designated annotation zones visually quiet. Never fill quiet zones with invented panels. Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.
VISUAL FORMAT: equal-burden-diptych
TEACHING PURPOSE: Give keeping and moving the event comparable human costs.
CAMERA: Deliberate wide diptych with balanced visual weight.
One editorial diptych of two equally weighted spaces in the SAME modest community room, separated by a narrow architectural doorway. LEFT: a closed cream booking folio on a table with neatly arranged personal belongings, suggesting existing plans. RIGHT: two empty chairs beside a window, suggesting people whose needs are unresolved. Warm-neutral consistent exposure and identical visual importance on both sides. No one is shown excluded in reality; this is comparison staging. No writing, maps, routes, signs, symbols, diagrams or success/failure colors. Both upper quadrants have smooth quiet plaster for exact overlay text.
COMPOSITING INTENT: A full-width diptych compares people affected on both sides, followed by a shared lower authority line. No arbitrary preferred side.
SEMANTIC AUTHORITY FOR CONTEXT ONLY, NEVER RENDER THESE WORDS: WORKED ANSWER / FICTIONAL. Make the authorized check. Completion overstates what we know; rescheduling exceeds the grant. Keeping the reservation preserves existing plans but leaves two members excluded. Moving it might help them but could harm others. Neither option has earned a claim that the outing works.
